title: A finished specialist's result reaches the next chat turn

steps.name: launch
steps.text: Dana at Northwind Dental says the x-ray workstation is crawling. Find out why and tell me what you'd do.

steps.name: result-posted
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from wisp_thread_posts where kind = 'specialist_result' and created_at > {{since}}

steps.name: verdict
steps.text: So what's the verdict on the x-ray box? And what do I tell Dana?

checks.pattern: (do(n'?t| not) have (a|the) (verdict|result)|nothing has come back|has(n'?t| not) (come back|reported|finished)|not (back|finished|done) yet|still (running|working|waiting))
checks.note: #11671: Wisp says the specialist has not reported although its report is in the thread

#11671 acceptance: the verdict comes from the delivered result with no tool call. Without delivery Wisp either re-reads the device (2026-11-10: get_device_details, wrong answer) or fetches the run itself (get_ai_agent_run)
